text: 当地时间9月2日，荷兰央行宣布，今年3至8月，将约86吨黄金储备从美国纽约、加拿大渥太华转移至英国伦敦，操作包含市场交易与实物调运两种方式。 荷兰央行表示，在日益不确定的全球环境下，此次调整核心目标是进一步加强危机应对能力；伦敦是全球实物黄金重要交易中心，从可售性与流动性角度具备额外优势，存放在此，危机情况下有助于实现更快速、更高效的交易和调动。该行称对北美托管黄金仍充满信心，目前尚无进一步搬迁计划。
text_en: On September 2 local time, the Dutch central bank announced that from March to August this year, approximately 86 tonnes of gold reserves were transferred from New York, USA and Ottawa, Canada to London, UK, involving both market transactions and physical transportation. The Dutch central bank stated that amid the increasingly uncertain global environment, the core goal of this adjustment is to further strengthen crisis response capabilities; London is an important global trading center for physical gold, offering additional advantages in terms of sellability and liquidity. Gold stored there helps achieve faster and more efficient trading and mobilization in crisis situations. The bank stated it remains confident in gold custodied in North America and currently has no plans for further relocation.
